settings.title: Stays exactly where you lay it
settings.body: The sleeve lies flat over the guard and does not creep. Woven shell, flat stitched seam, a low-profile branded tab. Nothing to catch, nothing to rattle, nothing hard against the paint.

settings.title: Sits flat under an indoor cover
settings.body: The sleeve lies flat on the panel, so a car cover drapes over it without bunching or dragging the cable when the cover moves.

settings.q: Will it fit my charger's cable?
settings.a: It slides over the cable of common battery tenders and trickle chargers. If your charger uses an unusually thick cable, contact us before ordering and we will confirm fit.
That is the entire point of the product. The shell is a soft matte woven fabric with a flat stitched seam. There are no hooks, magnets, zips or hard parts anywhere the car can feel.

settings.q: Does it work under a car cover?
settings.a: Yes. The sleeve sits flat on the bodywork, so an indoor cover drapes over it without bunching or pulling the cable.
Under a minute. Slide the sleeve along the run of cable that touches the car, position it, done. It stays in place for the whole storage season.
Yes. Orders ship from Australia with tracking. Duties and taxes for your country are shown or advised at checkout. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm DDP vs DDU before launch]

settings.q: What is the Twin Pack deal?
settings.a: Two sleeves with the second at half price. Most collections do not stop at one car, and neither does the cable problem.

settings.q: How do I care for the sleeve itself?
settings.a: A wipe with a damp microfibre cloth is all it needs. Keep compounds and solvents away from it, and if it ever needs more than a wipe, contact us before machine washing.
